nom: RMS Beauty Coconut Clean Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I accidentally found this cleanser, because I was searching for a clean cleanser. I use another name brand, but it wasn't as clean as I would have liked it to be. I tried RMS once and loved it so I just signed up for the subscription. I'm also anxious to try more of their products!
I am a coconut balm believer! The formula effectvely cleans away makeup and oil and leaves my skin feeling moisturized, and not dry or tight. Its like a 2-in-1 experience.

I LOVE this product. As cleansing balm, it feels great to use, and my skin is incredibly soft, hydrated, and feels clean and fresh afterwards. I have also found this to be a healing balm - it makes such a difference to leave on areas of my face overnight. And it smells great!

Love this !! Cleans everything including eyeshadows off, rinse with water and ready for hydrating mist and moisturiser. I am especially becoming aware of what is Clean Beauty and appreciate what RMS has done to keep this brand a part of that!
Love the deep cleaning and nourishing feel. My skin is soft and ultra clean

This is my third jar of RMS Coconut Clean Cleansing Balm—and I truly can't live without it! I use it every night as part of my super simple, highly effective RMS routine. It gently melts away makeup, grime, and whatever the day has brought, leaving my skin clean without feeling stripped. My entire skincare routine is RMS, and I love how everything works together so beautifully. I follow the cleansing balm with RMS Kakadu Oil and RMS moisturizer, and I wake up with hydrated, soft, glowing skin every morning. It's amazing. It's simple. It's perfect. It's RMS!

avis.titre: My 62 year old skin thanks RMS!
avis.texte: Never, have I EVER used a cleanser that has not left my skin parched and dry after using it until now! This is a miracle cleanser, in my eyes! I have thrown all of my expensive other cleanser away for for this cleansing balm!! My skin glows after I wash away the day with this balm.
I love this creamy cleanser. . It removes my makeup and leaves my face so smoorh. . It's quite a large jar. . Very well packaged.
I'm loving my coconut cleansing balm! It feels so nourishing. My skin is soft and looks like I've had special treatments. Dark spots are lighter and dry patches are gone.

FIrst time using a cleansing balm and liking it! Removes makeup gently and completely. I'm liking the no-drip quality of massaging it onto my skin. I remove the makeup/cleanser with a warm-wet disposable washcloth. Really nice.
This is such a soothing cleanser. Removes all that has been on my face without drying my skin. I like to smooth it on then wait a few minutes before rinsing. Good self care.
This product truly cleanses my face while effectively removing all the makeup that I've had on all day. Great product!
Love how this product cleans and leaves my skin feeling plump and luxurious. Does not leave my skin feeling oily. Looks great and feels smooth going on and when massaging into the skin.

This is the best product I have ever used for makeup removal. I use it at night to clean my face and my skin feels clean and refreshed, not dry or stripped. It even removes mascara easily. A little goes a long way providing coverage of my entire face. Thank you RMS Beauty!
Love! Easy to apply and feels great afterwards. I follow with another cleanser. It really removes makeup and mascara well.
Wonderful! Melts my makeup away in no time including eye makeup. Love that it turns milky when water is added.

This is absolutely the best cleansing and hydrating product on the market today. It is easy to apply and easy to remove which is super important. With some products you have to apply them twice to do a great job, not with this one.

I have been looking for a makeup remover that I like for a very long time. The several makeup removers I had tried would require me to wash my face 3 times and I would still sometimes have a little eye makeup left behind, but my skin would feel stripped. For reference, I do not use foundation and only use some blush, bronzer, concealer on the skin usually with a very simple smokey eye - usually my eyeliner smudged out and in the waterline. This is finally a cleanser that removes my makeup effectively and my skin feel hydrated afterwards. I will continue to buy this!
This coconut cleansing balm feels lightweight and clean. It works great and I love it

I am completely honest, was petrified to try this makeup removal cream. I have the most sensitive and reactive skin. Have spent a fortune on skin care that promises, but just another product I wasted my money on. This works, everything it says it does it doe! Absolutely no skin reaction, cleanses thoroughly, improves skin texture. I am shocked, something that is real. Thank you, a million times over.
Great oil based cleanser that removes make-up and won't overly dry your skin. It is a big jar which is nice as it will last a while. Very happy with my purchase.
I'll only ever use a cleansing balm as my face wash! So moisturizing, silky, and never greasy or heavy. My makeup comes off so easily! Plus, I love that there's no harsh fragrance either.

avis.titre: Great product; careful not to drop the jar!
avis.texte: I've been using this since shortly after it came out and love it. It's removes the makeup and leaves my skin feeling really nice, and then I use the cleansing gel after as instructed. I do not use the cleansing balm to love my eye makeup as it burned my eyes awfully. Tonight I dropped my cleansing balm and the glass shattered in a hundred pieces. Obviously one of the selling points of RMS products is that they packaged in glass, so user be careful. It took about 30 minutes to find all the shards and big and small pieces and clean them off the floor. My jar was about 75% full and unfortunately it's ruined. The remaining jar was crumbling and falling apart, and a good possibility of glass being in the cleansing balm. Money and product lost, sadly.
Love this! It gently removes makeup and leaves my skin clean, refreshed and nourished.
Absolutely love this cleanser! I have sensitive skin and this leaves my face looking fresh, hydrated and it smells divine. I look forward to washing my face everyday. Thanks RMS.
This cleanser takes off all of my makeup and leaves my skin silky and soft. I am hooked!
Excellent at removing makeup, but could be gentler to eyes and lashes
The best,i love the texture,is gentle and remove all the makeup is my lifesaver.

I have the raw coconut cream which I love. I decided to add the cleansing balm to my skincare routine and so glad I did! It is wonderful on the skin. . . not oily or greasy. My skin feels and looks wonderful. This product is a winner!

I was very excited to give this cleansing balm a try since I currently use the Elemis balm. The way this was packaged left a lot to be desired as it completely melted. . . I understand it's coconut oil. . . and leaked all over the paper bag my products were delivered in. It was even leaking through the mailer. Second, I found this balm very difficult to rinse off my face. Third, I found the texture a little strange when trying to get it out of the pot since I'm used to a cleansing balm being a little softer. I will absolutely continue to use it but, honestly, I melted this and my Elemis back down to oil and combined them.
This gets 5 stars, for sure! At the end of a long day I look forward to taking my makeup off, and cleansing my face and neck with this! It always leaves my skin, clean and feeling nourished. Love it!
Love this stuff. Gets all kinds of manipulation off my face!!
This worked great with my sensitive rosacea skin. Took off my mascara nicely also!
Great product! Love the consistency and how well it cleans my face. Wonderfully moisturizing without any greasiness. Got some for me and sent one to my mom for Mother's Day.
Do not know how I lived without this product! It is the first time in 62 yrs where my skin is NOT dry and tight after a wash my face. I am a fan for life!

The coconut clean cleansing balm is the perfect way to end the day, removing makeup and making my face feel like I've experienced a spa-like treatment- makes my face smell and feel so soft and hydrated! I actually look forward to cleaning my face with this product! Both cleansing coconut RMS products are unlike any that I've used in all my years! Many products boast their softening claim, but only these RMS coconut products deliver!

I LOVE it! basically coconut oil but creamy and without the greasiness. My mascara (which I lather on thick sometimes) literally glides away with this! The best part is it's moisturizing and not stripping to my skin.

I originally tried this out in a search for a very mild eye makeup remover. Surprisingly, this has helped so much with my rosacea! I use it every night, and my skin is basically back to normal—which is amazing. I'm not sure if this is attributable to the product, but the oil glands in my eyes did get irritated after use, which could just be me not washing it off thoroughly.

I use this exclusively now to remove my makeup and as a general first cleanse. I no longer have to scrub my eye makeup off. It just melts away and feeds my face while it's gently removing my makeup. It's a staple.
Love this! Love how it cleanses my skin without drying it out. Removes all my makeup, leaving my skin feeling clean and moisturized.

I love a cleansing balm and the RMS Coconut Clean Cleansing Balm is my new favorite. Like all RMS skincare products, the cleansing balm feels luxurious on the skin. I'm normally sensitive to coconut based products but the cleanser I was using wasn't removing all my makeup so I thought I'd give it a try. I am so glad I did and it's now part of my nighttime ritual. This balm melts away makeup and leaves your skin soft and smooth. If you're thinking about tying this product, do! You won't be disappointed.

avis.titre: Best balm I've used. No residue.
avis.texte: This is now the finest balm make up remover I have ever used and I've tried so many in my day. It doesn't have a heavy scent like my popular prior balm cleanser, it rinses off clean without a residue, my skin is not stripped. I use the balm as a 2nd cleanse always since I wear long wearing makeup and mineral sunblock which is vital to remove with a balm type or oil cleanser. However I dislike oils since they just don't seem to apply well. As an RMS devotee I finally found the one balm that makes removing my face a pleasant experience at the end of my day! TY Rose Marie :-)

This cleansing balm has a luxurious feel. I like the way it goes on as a balm and then with a touch of water becomes rich and creamy to remove makeup and sunscreen. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and night and not greasy. Simple and clean.

avis.titre: Great for removing thicker products like sunscreen
avis.texte: I live in Hawaii and wear sunscreen daily on my face and neck. I've been looking for a cleanser that easily removes sunscreen without scrubbing or dying the skin. I found it with the coconut clean cleansing balm. Leaves skin soft, moisturized and glowing even before moisturizing.

avis.titre: Best cleansing balm I've ever used
avis.texte: I use this balm in my nightly ritual. A little goes a long way and removes all my makeup. My skin feels hydrated too.

I used a cleansing balm from another company and was lost trying to find a new brand. I am very happy with coconut clean cleansing balm. It removes all my make-up from the day leaving my skin smooth and hydrated. It's a high quality product.
It isn't good. The balm feels nice on the skin, but it stings the eyes and I don't have sensitive eyes. I can't imagine buying a balm make up remover that I can't use on my eyes.

I love this product!! I believe it's my 3rd order. I have a terrible complexion. And my skin on my face has always been excessively dry with several patches of chronic scales. I am 73 years old and this is the first time in my adult life that I have found a product that actually moisturized the spots and stopped this chronic cycle. I can't say enough about it. Also love how soft and clear my skin looks overall. Thank you rms!! 💕

Absolutely love it. My skin never looked better especially since I live in a dry climate in AZ. My skin does not get oily and it is awesome for removing tube mascara. I absolutely love everything I have ordered from RMS.
Love this makeup remover. It removes my waterproof mascara easily and cleans my face well. Love how well it works and love that it is less toxic than other removers.
I love the way this cleansing balm cleans my face and leaves it feeling moisturized.

Love this cleansing balm! I use it as step 1 of my double cleanse. Removes all makeup, including eyeliner effectively while leaving skin soft, smooth and hydrated. It also works well in removing mascara after gentle stroking of the lashes with the balm (I use upward strokes as recommended by Rose Marie😉). I've repurchased it several times. If you're on the fence, give it a try!
This cleanser feels like a soothing emollient, and is the perfect makeup remover for the winter or any dry season. An essential
Love love love!! It removes makeup so well and leaves my face feeling so soft!! Ordering my second jar!
I like this for winter skin cleansing and removing sunscreen. Feels so nice !
Leaves my skin dry but doesn't seem to clean. I think it would work better with the cleansing cream Has a nice light scent
I was skeptical about trying this but am so glad I did. I love this cleanser! It's really amazing. It will always be a staple in my routine.
Biscuits every bit of dirt and make up my skin and leaves it so soft. Just love it.
I will never go back!! This balm is very expensive but also really incredible. It removes makeup so effectively and feels smooth and hydrating in the process. It's also fun to use!
Couldn't wait to purchase this and it didn't disappoint!! My makeup just melts away. Purchase it with the gel cleanser for a duo cleanse - glad I did!!
This has become one of my staples. Great product and your face loves you.

Coconut balm is the bomb. With the warmth of ur fingers it begins to melt and applied to the face it melts even better. RMS products are truly fantastic. The products use "clean" ingredients and you will notice the difference in your skin. Products are shipped in a timely manner and the packaging is nice. Will Definetly keep purchasing RMS products.
Cleansing Balm works great and is nourishing to melt your days makeup off from eyes to skin. Great usage for a double cleanse with the Cleansing Gel. I love both!
Nice and light cleansing balm that removes makeup easily. I like it!

I've purchased the cleansing balm (and duo) several times. It's gentle and effective, and has made my skin texture and tone better than it has been in more than 50 years. Makeup removers with long, confusing ingredient lists would break me out or make my skin super dry. This cleanser combines fabulous nourishing oils for the skin and will be my go-to from now on.

Okay, so the Coconut Clean Cleansing Balm is my new favorite cleanser. I love it and use it daily. Its so easy to use and takes every bit of make up off, leaving my skin clean and soft, but not greasy. Worth every dime spent. After using this, I cannot imagine ever using anything else.
Looove this! It takes my makeup off effortlessly and my face is smooth and clean.
This is the best make up remover I have ever used and smells so good.

This facial cleanser is divine. It is nourishing and leaves my skin feeling clean, healthy, and hydrated. It also works incredibly well to remove makeup. This was one of the first RMS products I tried and I love it so much I am changing over all of my skin and makeup from Origins Dr. Weil, NARS, and Bare Minerals to RMS. Thank you Rose-Marie!
Love the feel of this cleansing balm , the smell is wonderful after washing my face feels hydrated and clean.
This is luscious! It does a wonderful job of cleaning your face without stripping. Light, fresh scent and a rich texture make it a treat to wash your face.
Use to use Purity, but you his isn't new holy grail, and it feels so good!
OK, so this blew me out of the water I hear coconut oil. I'm thinking oh boy it's gonna be greasy. No way no greasy So wonderful on the skin I love this
Absolutely love this product. It works well to remove makeup and leaves your skin feeling moisturized
Honestly, the best cleanser you will ever use, especially if your skin is on the dry side. This removes make up perfectly while leaving your skin dewy soft.
Creamy, removes makeup beautifully and leaves my skin hydrated I have never used balms before to remove makeup but now I am hooked

avis.titre: This will be your new favorite
avis.texte: This is the best cleansing balm I have ever used . I actually look forward to taking my makeup off at night .

Such a wonderful, creamy cleanser that leaves my skin feeling so fresh and clean, but NOT leaving my skin barrier feeling depleted or dry. I love it and am currently waiting for my second order to arrive! So glad it finally came back in stock! FYI,I have dry, but acne-prone and sensitive skin and this has been a miracle.
Works wonderful to remove make up extremely light scent. I like the product a lot. You won't regret it.
This balm is amazing. Melts makeup away and leaves my skin feeling so soft. Love the subtle scent as well!!
This balm is great at removing "the day" from your face leaving it clean and soft!

avis.titre: Much better and cleaner dupe for the Elemis balm
avis.texte: I have been trying for a long time to find a dupe for the Elemis cleansing balm. I've tried oils that just leave a film on your face. Other balms I've tried don't get all of your makeup off or make your face feel stripped of moisture. This cleansing balm is the best!!!!! I will never use anything else again. It has clean ingredients, takes off all makeup and sunscreen while also leaving your face feeling so soft and moisturized.

Thee most luxurious cleansing balm that I don't even want to wash it off! Slight divine gentle fragrance. I resisted buying this as I had the coconut cream before, but I literally cant wait to wash my. face with this and/or the other newish cleanser that pairs with it. . . THAT too is heavenly!

avis.titre: My new go to makeup remover!
avis.texte: I work in a Dermatology office, so I've literally tried just about every product on the market. I use this as the first step in my skin care regimen. It literally melts the day off my face. It leaves my skin feeling soft & nourished, never tight or dry. It removes all of my makeup and sunscreen beautifully without excessive rubbing on my face. I love it & highly recommend this to anyone who appreciates clean skin care.
Felt good going on ... Cleaned well too, but didn't agree with my skin.
This is one of my favorite cleansers ever! I have switched completely from a cleansing oil to this balm. It feels good, works great and I will never not use it! I only wish it came in a bigger size!
I bought the small travel size to try and it's a wow factor product for me! It's creamy, hydrating, and removes all my makeup. I'll be purchasing the regular size now!
I fell in love with this product from day one. My skin feels soft and not oily after use. Definitely a product I will keep in my stash always
Cleanses beautifully without dryness - even removing mascara with ease. I appreciate that it is scent free too so it doesn't irritate my skin or eyes. And a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: Where have you been all my life?? :-)
avis.texte: This product is fabulous! It does a better job of removing my make-up and cleansing my skin than any other make-up remover or cleanser I've ever used -- softening my skin in the process and rinsing off so easily. It's a keeper!
The coconut cleanser is great. Take my makeup and dirt off of my face but doesn't irritate my skin
Wonderful! Love how it feels so luxurious and actually creamy. And how great it leaves your skin feeling! So soft.

I absolutely love this cleansing balm. Took off all my make up and left my skin feeling hydrated and not greasy. This is my first time using RMS beauty and so far love all their products. I have very sensitive skin and so far no problems with anything I ordered. I am looking forward to ordering more. Luxury in a jar. I'm going to treat myself and take advantage of all the holiday sales.
Love this as part of my double cleanse routine. Removes my makeup and does not hurt my eyes.
I love this. It removes makeup easily. It rinses clean. It feels good on my skin when I use it. Absolutely will buy again.
I love this cleansing balm! It removes everything without drying your skin!
I love this product. The texture, the smell and the feeling on my skin.
This cleansing balm is my new favorite for makeup removal. It's a perfect prep for nighttime serum/moisturizer, very gentle and soothing.

Even takes off mascara and eyeliner gently, without lots of rubbing. I was using micellar water to take off mascara but felt it was still a little rough on my eyes. I stopped wearing mascara for a while because I didn't have a product that removed it as gently as I wanted. During a free consult, the makeup specialist recommended this product and I decided to give it a try. It's wonderful and doesn't leave my middle-aged skin. Feeling dry after use. It's also pricey so I'm hoping it lasts a good long while!

The coconut clean cleansing balm is one of my favorite skin care products! I use it along with the cleansing gel, and my skin has never been as healthy or moisturized! It's the first step in my skin care and daily makeup routine.

avis.titre: I just purchased my second jar.
avis.texte: I use this cleansing balm nightly. I have now purchased my second jar and the balm lasts a very long time. . This balm takes off all of my make up leaving my skin very soft. I do follow this with a second cleanse most nights with the Cleansing Gel for an extra clean feel. My granddaughters like to use this when they stay over because the balm feels so good on their faces. Great product.
LOVE THIS - I have used several different brand versions of this, and this one is the best for removing my makeup without leaving my face feeling greasy.
Takes off makeup easily and quickly. Like, melts it away. Great product.

I use this cream several times a week when I have been out wearing makeup. It's easy to remove with a warm washcloth. I like to follow up with the liquid cleanser. It helps to keep my skin hydrated, especially with the indoor heat. I recommend this product.

I love this for cleaning the make up off my face at the end of the day. It feels very luxurious and gentle. It cleans my face very well. My skin does feel a bit dry afterwards, but I follow with the Kakadu oil and I'm good to go.
The absolute best makeup remover. It has helped my skin tremendously. When I traveled last week m, I used the last of another brand of a similar product. It was awful/ no comparison to this.

Unless you have a coconut allergy or sensitivity, just try it. I challenge you to not have at least a perfectly sufficient experience, but it's going to be better than that. This balm eats through the most caked on, built up mascara and lash primer layers within about 10 seconds of gentle massage. Anything else dissolves even faster, leaving behind soft, clean skin and NO FILM IN THE EYES. I was a Farmacy cleansing balm adherent for years but this stuff just works better with less effort and doesnt leave my eyes filmy and irritated. It rinses away clean and leaves soon feeling smooth but not tight or dry. The texture is excellent too, and you dont need much for the entire face as a little goes a long way. I'm hooked, I won't use anything else.
Love this stuff! Cleans mascara so well and is moisturizing at the same time. Won't go back to anything else.
leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. keeps its promise that it is not drying.
This cleanser feels cleans, minimizes pores and leave skin so hydrated!
